# Synthetic redaction fixture stories

M-01 selects only the optional code role. M-02 selects both roles through a fact type declaration. M-03 retains redundant declarations while deduplicating effective coordinates. M-04 exercises separate non-boolean and nested-form schema refusals. M-05 has no redaction declaration.

The finite seed, item, code and node values are fabricated. P4_SECRET_ values are deliberate taint canaries; P4_PUBLIC_ values are public controls. Redaction follows model coordinates, including equal scalar spellings at different coordinates.
